family: compatible two-subcube XOR masks with source independent of private blocks; unequal one-coordinate shared source cores, and arbitrary C,Y source
parameter_domain: (r,s,t,k)=(1,1,1,2),(2,1,1,2),(1,2,1,2),(1,1,2,2), all 256 ordered pairs of two-bit Boolean core tables, one reflected canonical event assignment each; (2,1,1,1) all 256 Boolean sources g(C,Y), canonical event. Two explicit witnesses.
symmetry: Independent coordinate reflections send any compatible common/private assignment to the all-zero assignment. These preserve each fixed tree cell, physical influence and Gamma. Reflections of shared source coordinates permute the exhaustively included source truth tables; reflection of the distinguished shared bit exchanges the exhaustively included ordered core pair. Thus canonical assignment suffices for this validation domain.
